filament_notes: SUNLU High Speed Matte PETG 1.75 mm, 1 kg. SimplyPrint/Open Filament Database: nozzle 240-260 C, bed 70-80 C, density 1.28. printer-hub.ru: 240-250 C for 100-300 mm/s, 260-270 C above 300 mm/s, dry 65 C 6 h, not abrasive. Max-flow test on T1 (0.4 HF, 255 C, ramp up to 34.9 mm3/s): clean to the top, so cap 30 (about 85 percent of the tested top; the real limit is higher). 250/245 C because the spool lists 240-255 C for 100-300 mm/s and the print looked better at the fast end, so 255 C is hot for slow parts. PA 0.048 from the Sunlu PETG tune.
